instruction: Create a new contact for Ada Lovelace. Their number is 555-0142.

oracle.command: content insert --uri content://com.android.contacts/raw_contacts --bind account_name:n: --bind account_type:n:; id=$(content query --uri content://com.android.contacts/raw_contacts --projection _id | tail -1 | sed 's/.*_id=//'); content insert --uri content://com.android.contacts/data --bind raw_contact_id:i:$id --bind mimetype:s:vnd.android.cursor.item/name --bind data1:s:'Ada Lovelace'; content insert --uri content://com.android.contacts/data --bind raw_contact_id:i:$id --bind mimetype:s:vnd.android.cursor.item/phone_v2 --bind data1:s:5550142 --bind data2:i:2
